title: QAPassCriteria
description: Policy for when a work item's QA is considered passed. All fields optional with defaults. Enforcement follows AEF QA_GOVERNANCE.md 'Evidence Rows & Determinations': skipped-by-authority gates are respected (not treated as FAIL), NOT_EXECUTED gates are not silently passed and required-not-executed rows surface a formal determination path (Human Decision) rather than hanging, and optional/NOT_EXECUTED gates are non-blocking.

allRequiredGatesMustPass.description: Whether every required gate must pass for QA to be passed. A gate is considered passing when passed, waived (SKIPPED with authority_ref), or not_applicable; a required gate left not_executed or skipped without an authority reference is blocking.

optionalGateFailuresAllowed.description: Number of non-required gate failures tolerated

waiverRequiresHumanDecision.description: Whether waiving a failed gate requires a durable human decision
